certificates.description: Certificates to serve a hostname with, keyed by hostname, valued by the path to the certificate on the machine.

deployKey.description: Path to the public key the ocel-deploy login accepts; defaults to the bootstrapping login's keys.

ssh.description: The machine to deploy onto: a Host alias from ssh_config, or the destination spelled out.

host.description: The hostname or address to reach the machine at.

identityFile.description: The private key to authenticate with, as a path.

port.description: The port sshd listens on. Omit it and ssh's own default stands.

user.description: The account to log in as. Omit it and ssh resolves the user itself.
